name: telegram-lead-extractor
description: Export member information (name, @username, ID) visible in Telegram Web groups to CSV, Excel, or JSON.

scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -f telegram-lead-extractor.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../telegram-lead-extractor.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo 'Packaged -> telegram-lead-extractor.zip'
